## Natural history notes

A microscopic freshwater green alga composed of slender, spindle-shaped to needle-like cells that may occur singly or in small groups. Ankistrodesmus fusiformis is a member of the green algal family Selenastraceae and occurs as part of the phytoplankton in freshwater habitats such as ponds, lakes, and slow-moving waters. Like other phytoplanktonic green algae, it contributes to primary production by converting sunlight and dissolved nutrients into biomass that supports aquatic food webs.
